Subject: Post-call: next steps and technical deep-dive

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for walking through SolidWell's streaming ingestion and low-latency SLA needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Recap: primary need is inference for real-time clinical summarization at ~200 req/s with 150ms p95 target for short prompts; data residency requirement in us-west; preference for autoscaling during peak hours.
- Ask: please confirm who from your CloudOps/security team should join the technical deep-dive. We want someone who can speak to networking (VPC peering/firewalls) and KMS for key management.

Proposed deep-dive slots (60m):
1) Tue, Mar 30 — 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed, Mar 31 — 14:00–15:00 PT

If neither works, share a couple windows and we’ll adjust. I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that shows the typical timeline for Dedicated or Private deployments.

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf, Proposed-MAP.xlsx

Next steps on our side: I’ll draft a calendar invite once you confirm the preferred slot and attendees. Rishi (cc) — can you standby for capacity/architecture questions in the deep-dive?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
